title: Implicit transverse coordinates and regular coefficient calculus
statement:
Let $k$ have characteristic zero and let $B$ be smooth of finite type over $k$, with an etale coordinate chart $(w_1,\ldots,w_m,y_1,\ldots,y_r)$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let regular functions $h_1,\ldots,h_r$ vanish at $a$ and have invertible $y$-Jacobian there. After restricting to its nonvanishing locus, $N=V(h_1,\ldots,h_r)$ is smooth, and $w$ is an etale coordinate system on $N$. At every $b\in N$, put $L=\kappa(b)$. In the Taylor ring there is a unique vector $\phi_b(W)\in(W)L[[W]]^r$ solving $h_b(W,\phi_b(W))=0$, and
$$h_b(W,Y)=U_b(W,Y)(Y-\phi_b(W))$$
with $U_b$ an invertible formal matrix [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. The substitution $Y=\phi_b(W)+Z$ is an invertible continuous change of variables and identifies the extended ideal of $N$ with $(Z)$. Coordinate derivations of regular functions in an etale chart remain regular and commute with Taylor expansion [def-trf-formal-power-series-partial-derivative]. More generally, for any family $F=\sum_\gamma c_\gamma(w,y)T^\gamma$ with regular coefficients and finitely many formal variables $T$, the coefficient of $Z^\delta T^\gamma$ after this substitution is the Taylor expansion on $N$ of $(\partial_y^\delta c_\gamma)|_N/\delta!$. These formulas commute with residue-field extension. The local Taylor map from a smooth chart to $L[[W,Y]]$ is faithfully flat, also at nonclosed points; consequently equality of extended finitely generated ideals implies equality of their stalk ideals, and equality of stalks of two coherent ideals extends to a neighbourhood. Here $k$ is a field, $B$ denotes the smooth $k$-scheme, and an etale coordinate chart means that $(w,y):B\to\mathbf A_k^{m+r}$ is etale. For $b\in N$, the centered Taylor map $\tau_b:\mathcal O_{B,b}\to L[[W,Y]]$ is the composite through the completed local ring of $B_L=B\times_k\operatorname{Spec}L$ at the $L$-rational point $b_L$ induced by $b$. It sends $w_i$ to $w_i(b)+W_i$ and $y_j$ to $y_j(b)+Y_j$; write $h_b=\tau_b(h)$. The Taylor map on $N$ is defined in the same way using its coordinates $w$. Thus the coefficient assertion means $[Z^\delta T^\gamma]F_b(W,\phi_b(W)+Z,T)=\tau^N_b((\partial_y^\delta c_\gamma)|_N)/\delta!$, where $F_b=\sum_\gamma\tau_b(c_\gamma)T^\gamma$. The residue fields, local rings, affine spaces, completions, differential operators, coherent ideals and faithful flatness use [def-weil-residue-field], [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], [def-sbc-affine-space], [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], [pqf-def-coherent] and [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map].

source.place: VIII 2.3.11 and 2.3.13, pp.93--94, referring to Bierstone--Milman, Invent. Math. 128 (1997), 207--302; detailed input Lemma 3.5 and Remarks 3.7, 9.9 and 9.11 (pp.231--232,279--280); faithful-flat Taylor realization at nonclosed points is the algebraic extension using the completed diagonal after residue-field extension. No Stacks tag states this result; journal text read through the publisher-version PDF online, absent from the repository literature.

proof.text: Use [lem-trf-etale-coordinate-derivations-jacobian] to obtain the regular commuting coordinate derivatives and $\mathrm dc=\sum D_ic\,\mathrm dx_i$. Where $\det D_yh\ne0$, the change from $(\mathrm dw,\mathrm dy)$ to $(\mathrm dw,\mathrm dh)$ has block triangular invertible matrix. By [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf] and [lem-weil-pbc-spec-tilde-stalk-localization] its fibre is the differential-sheaf fibre. Thus [lem-pur-etale-at-point-from-differentials] makes $(w,h)$ etale there, pointwise and hence on that open. The inverse image of $\mathbf A^m\times\{0\}$ is scheme-theoretically $N=V(h)$, so [lem-weil-pbc-etale-scheme-base-change] makes $w:N\to\mathbf A^m$ etale. Smoothness of $N$ follows from [sbc-lem-affine-space-smooth], [lem-weil-pbc-etale-smooth-zero-dimensional-fibres], and smooth composition via [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map-iff-smooth-affine] and [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map-base-change-composition]. The open contains $a$ by hypothesis.

For any $b\in N$, apply [lem-trf-diagonal-taylor-faithful-flatness] to both charts to construct $\tau_b$ and $\tau_b^N$ by completion at the residue-field diagonal points. The ambient Taylor map is faithfully flat, including when $b$ is nonclosed, and both maps commute with residue-field extension.

source.place: Tag 0H1D (lemma-formally-etale-lift-infinitesimal), inverse limit of its canonical quotients; Morphisms Tag 02GO. The completion is at b_L, not at b.

proof.text: On an affine chart take $D=A/(h)$ in [lem-trf-etale-graph-taylor-comparison]. Its hypotheses hold by step 1 and the Taylor coordinate values of step 2. It gives $\phi_j=\tau_b^N(y_j|_N)-y_j(b)$, the restriction identity $\tau_b(c)(W,\phi)=\tau_b^N(c|_N)$, and uniqueness of $\phi$ among all solutions of $h_b(W,\phi)=0$, compatibly with field extension.

source.place: Tag 04FF (lemma-unramified-flat-formally-etale), repeated unique lifts into the explicitly specified finite quotients; formal-series comparison supplied here.

proof.text: By [lem-trf-etale-coordinate-derivations-jacobian], $\partial_Y^\delta\tau_b(c)=\tau_b(D_y^\delta c)$. The constant-term evaluation in step 2 identifies $(\partial_Yh_b)(0,0)$ with $D_yh(b)$, invertible on the chosen open. Apply [lem-trf-formal-transverse-shift-calculus] to $h_b$ and $f_\gamma=\tau_b(c_\gamma)$. Its factorization gives the asserted invertible $U_b$ and graph ideal; its shift sends that ideal to $(Z)$. Its coefficient formula, followed by the restriction identity of step 3, is exactly $\tau_b^N((D_y^\delta c_\gamma)|_N)/\delta!$. All constructions commute with field extensions by steps 2--3 and the formal shift lemma.

source.place: Agent multivariate binomial coefficient calculation in the coefficient-family definition. Bierstone--Milman Lemma 3.5 and Remark 3.7 are motivational sources, not used as unverified inputs.

proof.text: Contract equal extended ideals along the faithfully flat Taylor map using [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ideal-contraction]. For coherent ideals equal at $b$, on an affine neighbourhood write $I=(f_i)$ and $J=(g_j)$ using [pqf-def-coherent]; [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-module-support-closed] identifies their stalks with localizations. Choose $u_i,v_j\notin\mathfrak p_b$ with $u_if_i\in J$ and $v_jg_j\in I$. On $D(\prod_i u_i\prod_jv_j)$ every multiplier is a unit, so both generator inclusions hold and the ideal sheaves agree. Empty products equal $1$.

source.place: Tag 01Y3 (lemma-local-isomorphism), local vanishing principle; here the ideal equality is proved explicitly with the finitely many localization multipliers, using Morphisms Tag 056J for the affine stalk identifications.

proof_origin.place: VIII Remarks 2.3.11 and 2.3.13, printed pp.93--94, provide the resolution context only. The detailed coordinate-calculus proof is supplied here using the cited Stacks infinitesimal lifting, differentials and completion results; the unavailable Bierstone--Milman text is not used as a black-box proof.

lean.statement: theorem implicitTaylorCoordinateCalculus {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k] (B : Scheme.{u}) {m r : ℕ} (c : MvPolynomial (Fin m ⊕ Fin r) k →+* Γ(B, ⊤)) (hc : Etale (implicitCoordinateMorphism c)) (hs : Smooth (implicitStructureMorphism c)) (hft : LocallyOfFiniteType (implicitStructureMorphism c) ∧ QuasiCompact (implicitStructureMorphism c)) : ∃ D : ImplicitCoordinateDerivations B c, (∀ x : B, ∃ T : B.presheaf.stalk x →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin m ⊕ Fin r) (B.residueField x), isTaylorMap (implicitCoordinatesAt c x) (B.residue x).hom T ∧ (∀ T' : B.presheaf.stalk x →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin m ⊕ Fin r) (B.residueField x), isTaylorMap (implicitCoordinatesAt c x) (B.residue x).hom T' → T' = T) ∧ T.FaithfullyFlat ∧ ∀ I J : Ideal (B.presheaf.stalk x), I.FG → J.FG → Ideal.map T I = Ideal.map T J → I = J) ∧ ∀ (h : Fin r → Γ(B, ⊤)) (a : B), (∀ i : Fin r, B.Γevaluation a (h i) = 0) → B.Γevaluation a (implicitJacobian D h) ≠ 0 → Nonempty (ImplicitTaylorCalculus.{u, v} B c h a D)
